completionPolicy: A surface is complete only when its authoritative symbol or document inventory is generated, every item is classified, freshness is checked in CI, and claimed runtime behavior has the declared verification evidence.

integrationSurfaces.notes: All stable declaration symbols are inventoried; mapped means classified, not necessarily a standalone MCP tool or live-host proof.
All declarations in Adobe's UXP 7.3 type package are inventoried and classified separately from the Premiere DOM; mapped remains static panel evidence, not licensed-host proof.
Supported HTML elements and attributes affect the packaged panel, not the MCP command catalog.
Supported CSS properties and features affect the packaged panel, not the MCP command catalog.
Spectrum UI coverage is a panel compatibility concern and must not inflate editing-tool coverage.
Manifest, entrypoint, lifecycle, packaging, distribution, and recipe pages are classified in the live-sitemap inventory; implementation remains partial.

integrationSurfaces.versionSource: UXP Hybrid Plugin SDK from Adobe Developer Console
integrationSurfaces.notes: The downloadable SDK headers are access-controlled. The header receipt and standalone verifier can account for an authorized artifact without copying it; a local addon-layout receipt can additionally account for the public root main.js entrypoint and three-target bundle layout without copying source or binaries. A schema-v2 local CCX archive receipt can bind that current layout receipt to the byte-identical required files, a full safe ZIP entry-name-set digest, matching local ZIP headers, and any required streamed data-descriptor CRC/sizes without copying archive contents or entry names. A schema-v3 candidate benchmark must bind its runs to matching verified SDK, addon-layout, and current local CCX receipts, but remains disabled until exact SDK, reproducible builds, signing/notarization, and cross-platform evidence are available.

integrationSurfaces.versionSource: Premiere Pro C++ SDK from Adobe Developer Console
integrationSurfaces.notes: The standalone PrSDK for native importers, exporters, effects, transitions, devices, and related plug-ins is distinct from UXP Hybrid addons. The header receipt and standalone verifier can account for an authorized artifact, but the access-controlled SDK documentation and headers are still required.

integrationSurfaces.versionSource: Premiere Pro Scripting Guide and bundled host DOM
integrationSurfaces.notes: Every object member documented by the pinned community scripting guide is inventoried. The executable cheat sheet remains curated, and community coverage is not Adobe authority or proof of runtime compatibility.
Every file in the pinned Adobe CEP Resources tree and Premiere PProPanel sample subtree is inventoried and classified; implementation remains partial.
Adobe publishes no authoritative QE reference. Runtime probes and explicit experimental boundaries remain required.

competitorSources.adoptionBoundary: Arbitrary code generation is already authority-gated in this project; no unsafe default parity is permitted.
Compare named tools and host scripts against current catalog before treating any advertised family as a gap.
README tool-count claims are not implementation or licensed-host evidence; source extraction is required.
Outcome workflows must be independently implemented with exact target, confirmation, and verification contracts.
